title: Send an estimate by text as well

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: An estimate goes to your client by email. You can text them the link at the same time.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: Open the client. Here, Imani Brewster, in Dallas.

steps.caption: A draft estimate
steps.narration: Under Estimates is a draft that has not been sent yet.

steps.caption: Also text it
steps.narration: Beside the Send button is a box called Also text it.

steps.caption: Emailed and texted
steps.narration: The CRM confirms the estimate was emailed, and texted.

steps.caption: The client's mobile
steps.narration: The text goes to the mobile number on the client's page, with a link to the estimate.

steps.caption: Settings
steps.narration: To have the box ticked every time, go to Settings.

steps.caption: Text estimates to clients
steps.narration: Scroll down to the SMS card, and switch on Text estimates to clients.

steps.caption: Your text number
steps.narration: Texts are sent from your own text number, shown just above.

steps.caption: Still your choice each time
steps.narration: You can still untick the box on any single send.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Send is on each estimate, on the client's page under Clients.

youtube.title: How to text an estimate to a client | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Send an estimate by email and text at the same time in the ConstructHUB CRM. Tick Also text it beside Send, or make it the default in Settings. Recorded in a demo workspace with a stand-in texting number; no real message is sent.
